text.en: The obstacle in the path becomes the path. What stands in the way becomes the way.
text.ko: 앞을 막는 것이 곧 길이 된다. 걸림돌이 곧 디딤돌이다.
text.zh-cn: 阻碍你的东西，会成为你的路；挡在前方的，就是前进的方向。
text.fr: L'obstacle devient le chemin. Ce qui barre la route devient la route.

caption.en:
The obstacle is the path. Not a slogan — a shape.

#fable #quotes #quoteoftheday #wisdom #motivation
caption.ko:
걸림돌은 길이 된다. 구호가 아니라 형태다.

#명언 #오늘의명언 #우화 #위로 #동기부여

en: Putting things off needs no reason.

moral.en: The place that snags you is the handle.

characters: a man in his 30s, short black hair, worn grey shirt, thin frame

cta.en: Follow @shinsegi.en — a new story every day

scenes.image_prompt: quiet stone corridor at dawn, long shadow across the floor, distant small figure walking away, long shot

narration.en: The obstacle in the path becomes the path. What stands in the way becomes the way. — Marcus Aurelius.
narration.ko: 앞을 막는 것이 곧 길이 된다. 걸림돌이 곧 디딤돌이다. — 마르쿠스 아우렐리우스.
narration.zh-cn: 挡在路上的东西，就是路本身。
narration.fr: L'obstacle sur le chemin devient le chemin.

scenes.image_prompt: narrow apartment hallway at night, shoes piled by the door, small figure standing still, seen from behind

narration.en: Putting things off needs no reason. Today just wasn't the day
narration.ko: 미루는 데는 이유가 필요 없다. 그냥 오늘이 아니었을 뿐이다
narration.zh-cn: 拖延从来不需要理由。只是今天不合适罢了。
narration.fr: Remettre à plus tard n'a pas besoin de raison. Aujourd'hui, ce n'était juste pas le jour.

scenes.image_prompt: narrow alley at dawn, old wooden door ajar, small figure before it, seen from behind

narration.en: One door at the end of the alley stuck for three days.
narration.ko: 골목 끝 문 하나가 사흘째 걸려 있었다.
narration.zh-cn: 巷子尽头那扇门卡了三天。
narration.fr: Au bout de la ruelle, une porte bloquait depuis trois jours.

scenes.image_prompt: small desk by a window at noon, wood shavings and a plane, faint figure in the middle distance, wide shot

narration.en: I sat at the desk with a plane in my hand.
narration.fr: Je me suis assis au bureau, un rabot à la main.

scenes.image_prompt: wooden staircase in the afternoon, door frame leaning on the step, distant small figure sitting, long shot

narration.en: The more I shaved, the more the door leaned.
narration.fr: Plus je rabotais, plus la porte penchait.

scenes.image_prompt: bus stop at dusk, empty bench, distant small figure waiting, wide shot

narration.en: At the bus stop I thought about the bent edge.
narration.fr: À l'arrêt de bus, j'ai repensé au bord courbé.

scenes.image_prompt: kitchen at night, one drawer open, small figure reaching inside, seen from behind

narration.en: In the kitchen I found a handle.
narration.zh-cn: 在厨房，我找到一个把手。
narration.fr: Dans la cuisine, j'ai trouvé une poignée.

scenes.image_prompt: classroom in the morning, empty chairs, distant small figure standing by a desk, long shot

narration.en: A man who stuttered chewed on his words.
narration.zh-cn: 结巴的人把话嚼了很久。
narration.fr: Un homme qui bégayait mâchait ses mots.

scenes.image_prompt: library shelf at night, one book open on a table, small figure reading far off, wide shot

narration.en: Those chewed words are his writing now.
narration.ko: 그 곱씹은 문장이 지금 그의 글이 되었다.
narration.zh-cn: 那些嚼过的话，成了他的文章。
narration.fr: Ces mots mâchés sont devenus ses textes.

scenes.image_prompt: empty bridge over a river at dawn, railing, one distant figure leaning, long shot

narration.en: The place that snags you is the handle.
narration.zh-cn: 卡住你的地方，最后成了把手。
narration.fr: L'endroit qui accroche devient la poignée.
